name: Nova Scotia Nominee Program (NSNP)
name_fr: Programme des candidats de la Nouvelle-Écosse
description: Skilled-worker streams of the Nova Scotia Nominee Program (NSNP) and whether they run through Express Entry (an Express Entry-aligned nomination adds 600 CRS points).

attributes.legal_status: in force on the access date (provincial programme under a federal–provincial agreement)

skilled_worker_streams.summary: Full-time permanent job offer from a NS employer, 1 year related experience, high-school diploma, age 21–55
Nova Scotia invites selected Express Entry candidates directly

attributes.express_entry_aligned: Yes — Labour Market Priorities (and other Express Entry streams)
attributes.notes: One-time expansion of 2026 selection priorities announced 14 July 2026. Application fees introduced from 1 September 2026 (amount not confirmed).
attributes.status_dependency: Eligibility depends on occupation (NOC/TEER), job offer, language scores and existing ties to the province — all unknown (USER-PROFILE.md; OPEN-QUESTIONS.md items 2, 4, 7).

sources.title: Labour Market Priorities stream
sources.publisher: Government of Nova Scotia (Nova Scotia Immigration)

verification.notes: Read through search-engine extracts of the provincial programme's official pages, not fetched in full.

limitations: Stream rules change several times a year and intake is often by invitation only; read the provincial guide in force before applying.
